TS015 no-lambda

A named function carries a name in the traceback, where a lambda carries none.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable
zig: Zig's anonymous function is a named fn on an anonymous struct, `struct { fn lessThan(...) ... }.lessThan`, which TigerBeetle itself writes 145 times as the comparator idiom; the naming sentence the rule cites is met by the fn name, so the shape is not reported

TigerStyle: "Get the nouns and verbs just right. Great names are the essence of great code, they capture what a thing is or does, and provide a crisp, intuitive mental model."
TigerStyle: "All control flow should be handled by one function, the rest shouldn't care about control flow at all. In other words, push ifs up and fors down."
